ad_info.reference_style: Clean, modern progress ad: three circular photo frames of increasing size threaded on one horizontal timeline, showing the same woman at three moments of her first month, with the product anchoring the bottom

global_identity.visual_style: Clean, bold and modern direct-response wellness ad: flat or softly graded brand-colored backgrounds, thick condensed headlines, natural warm photography of young Colombian women in everyday moments, shown from the waist up or in action
global_identity.visual_atmosphere: Warm, honest, feminine and close: morning light, home breakfast table, the calm feeling of a small daily ritual. Confident and optimistic, never clinical and never body-shaming
global_identity.graphic_language: Flat mustard-yellow (#C0B116) color fields and deep navy (#1C305F) graphic elements, rounded pills, thin lines, strong contrast, generous margins, no foliage clutter

creative_objective: Tell the first month of the daily ritual as a three-stage progression (start, more energy, more appetite) that the viewer reads left to right in one second. The progress is shown through the woman's face, mood and breakfast, never through her body. It must feel honest: these are experiences many women report, not guarantees.

art_direction.design_quality: Premium, polished, modern, scroll-stopping, professionally designed, commercially strong
art_direction.visual_hierarchy: 1) Bold headline at the top. 2) The three circular photos read left to right as growth: small, medium, large, with the largest circle ringed in deep navy. 3) The product centered in the bottom band. 4) The small time-label pills on top of each circle and the short caption under each one.
art_direction.composition_style: Horizontal left-to-right progression with deliberate size growth. Headline centered in the top band. Three circular photo frames side by side with their centers on the same horizontal line at about 46% of the canvas height: circle 1 about 20% of the canvas width in diameter (centered at about 17% of the width), circle 2 about 25% (centered at about 43%), circle 3 about 32% (centered at about 75%). A thin timeline track runs behind the circles through their centers, with a small chevron arrow pointing right in each gap. A rounded time-label pill straddles the top edge of each circle. A one-line caption sits centered under each circle on a shared baseline. The product stands centered in the bottom band, about 20-22% of the canvas height.
art_direction.spacing_and_structure: Vertical bands: headline from about 6% to 19% of the canvas height; circles between about 30% and 62%; captions on one shared baseline from about 65% to 71%; product band from about 74% to 95%. Safe margins of about 6-7% on every side. Nothing touches the canvas edges and nothing overlaps the photos except the label pills on their top edge.
art_direction.lighting_and_depth: Inside the circles: identical camera angle, crop and window-light setup across all three stages so only the mood and the breakfast change; stage 1 slightly cooler and more muted, stage 2 neutral, stage 3 warmest and most vibrant. Each circle has a thin white outline and a soft drop shadow; circle 3 adds a deep navy ring and a faint glow. The product gets a soft studio key light from the upper left and a soft contact shadow.
art_direction.conversion_feel: The ad must feel persuasive, eye-catching, emotionally engaging, credible, elegant and commercially strong

reference_structure_analysis.layout_summary: Square canvas with a flat mustard-yellow background. Headline centered at the top. Across the middle, three circular photos of the same young woman at her breakfast table grow in size from left to right (small, medium, large) along a thin horizontal timeline track that runs through their centers, with a small chevron arrow in each gap. A small rounded time-label pill sits on the top edge of each circle, and the largest circle is ringed in deep navy. A short caption sits under each circle on a shared baseline. The product stands centered in the bottom band with a soft shadow.

visual_prompt: Square 1:1 static ad, clean modern timeline layout on a flat mustard-yellow (#C0B116) background with a very subtle gradient that is slightly lighter at the top. TOP BAND (about 6% to 19% of the height): a bold centered two-line headline in a thick condensed sans-serif (Anton), deep navy (#1C305F), with the last three words in white. MIDDLE (about 30% to 62% of the height): three circular photographs side by side whose centers share one horizontal line at about 46% of the height and that GROW from left to right: the first circle is small (about 20% of the canvas width, centered at about 17% of the width), the second is medium (about 25%, centered at about 43%), the third is large (about 32%, centered at about 75%). A thin timeline line runs behind the circles through their centers from the left margin to the right margin, soft white on the left turning deep navy on the right, with one small chevron arrow pointing right in each gap between circles. All three circles show the SAME young Colombian woman (about 26 years old, slim face, long dark hair in a loose bun, plain white t-shirt), photographed from the shoulders up, seated at the same breakfast table by a window, same frontal eye-level camera angle, same crop, same morning window light. Circle 1 (smallest, slightly cool and muted tones): she looks sleepy and low on energy, chin resting on her hand, with only a small cup of coffee in front of her. Circle 2 (medium, neutral natural tones): she is awake and sitting upright with a soft smile, a glass of orange juice and a small bowl of fruit in front of her. Circle 3 (largest, warm and vibrant tones): she has a big genuine smile and holds a fork in front of a full Colombian breakfast with an arepa, scrambled eggs, fruit and juice. Her face and body shape are identical in the three circles; only her mood, her energy and the breakfast change. Each circle has a thin white outline and a soft drop shadow; the third circle also has a deep navy (#1C305F) ring about 1% of the canvas width thick and a faint glow. A small rounded pill label straddles the top edge of each circle, centered on it: the first two pills are white with navy text, the third pill is solid deep navy with white text. Under each circle, on one shared baseline at about 65% to 71% of the height, a short one-line caption in deep navy, in a friendly handwritten font (Caveat, bold). BOTTOM BAND (about 74% to 95% of the height): the product stands centered, front view, about 21% of the canvas height, with soft studio light from the upper left and a soft contact shadow. The product is the amber glass dropper bottle with a black rubber-bulb dropper cap and a yellow-to-white label shown in the attached product image: use the attached product image as the only source of truth for the product and reproduce it exactly as it is, same shape, cap, label, colors and proportions; do not redesign, replace or reinterpret it. Do not reproduce the yellow circle with the text 60ml from the corner of the product photo. Generous margins of about 6-7% on every side; nothing touches the edges and nothing overlaps the photos except the pill labels. No product inside the circles. No body or weight comparisons, no before/after split, no CTA button, no price, no badges, no stars, no icons, no benefit list, no bottom bar, no logos.

mandatory_visual_elements: Three circular photo frames growing in size from left to right (about 20%, 25% and 32% of the canvas width)
The same woman, crop and lighting in all three circles, shoulders up at a breakfast table, with a believable progression in mood and breakfast from cool and muted to warm and vibrant
Thin horizontal timeline track through the circle centers with a chevron arrow in each gap
Deep navy ring and faint glow on the largest circle
Rounded time-label pill on the top edge of each circle
The product from the attached photo centered in the bottom band with a soft contact shadow
final_generation_exclusions: No body, weight or figure comparisons; never show the woman below the shoulders
No fourth circle and no rectangular panels
No yellow 60ml circle copied from the product photo
Do not add any visual module that is not described in this prompt.
Do not add any text that is not listed in the EXACT VISIBLE TEXT section.

Do not add CTA buttons, prices, badges, benefits, icons, trust seals, ratings, testimonials, bottom bars, discount labels, offer boxes or extra claims unless they are explicitly listed in detected_visual_blocks or text_layers.
Preserve the translated structure exactly. Do not complete or improve the layout with additional advertising elements.
meta_policy_check: All visible text has been sanitized for Facebook/Instagram Ads compliance. No prohibited claims, no false guarantees and no direct personal attribute callouts. The progression shows energy and appetite as experiences many women report, with no body-change promise and no body before/after.
language_rule: All visible text inside the generated image must be written in Spanish.
